# watchpoint_alert_profile (Data Source)

Looks up a single alert profile by name within the tenant. Returns the scalar profile fields only; notification channels are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_alert_profile" "default" {
  name = "Default Alert Profile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the alert profile to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `cooldown_minutes` (Number) Minutes to suppress repeat alerts after firing.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) Alert profile ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the tenant's default alert profile.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the profile is enabled.
- `is_global` (Boolean) Whether this is a global, system-managed profile.
